# BBC
> BBC is a global public service media organization offering trusted news, sport, business, culture, travel, audio, and video coverage.

BBC.com is the international-facing home for BBC journalism and media, with major hubs for breaking news, live coverage, sport, business, innovation, climate, culture, travel, and multimedia storytelling.

## Home & Main Hubs
- [BBC Home](https://www.bbc.com/): Main homepage featuring top stories, analysis, sport, culture, and multimedia highlights.
- [BBC News](https://www.bbc.com/news): Central news hub for breaking stories, live pages, analysis, and global coverage.
- [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.com/sport): Sports hub with live scores, fixtures, results, commentary, and major event coverage.
- [BBC Business](https://www.bbc.com/business): Business news hub covering markets, companies, work, and the global economy.
- [BBC Innovation](https://www.bbc.com/innovation): Coverage of technology, science, AI, and emerging ideas shaping society.
- [BBC Culture](https://www.bbc.com/culture): Arts and culture hub with features on film, TV, music, books, and design.
- [BBC Travel](https://www.bbc.com/travel): Travel journalism focused on destinations, food, culture, and local perspectives.
- [BBC Audio](https://www.bbc.com/audio): Audio hub for podcasts, radio, music mixes, and on-demand listening.

## News Regions & World Coverage
- [World](https://www.bbc.com/news/world): International news coverage across continents, conflicts, diplomacy, and major global developments.
- [US & Canada](https://www.bbc.com/news/us-canada): News from the United States and Canada, including politics and society.
- [UK](https://www.bbc.com/news/uk): National UK news with politics, public services, crime, and major events.
- [Africa](https://www.bbc.com/news/world/africa): News and analysis from across the African continent.
- [Asia](https://www.bbc.com/news/world/asia): Coverage of politics, business, disasters, and regional developments across Asia.
- [Europe](https://www.bbc.com/news/world/europe): European news covering politics, war, economics, and social change.
- [Latin America](https://www.bbc.com/news/world/latin_america): Reporting on politics, security, economics, and culture across Latin America.
- [Middle East](https://www.bbc.com/news/world/middle_east): News and analysis on conflict, diplomacy, and regional affairs.

## UK Nations & Politics
- [Politics](https://www.bbc.com/news/politics): UK political reporting, elections, policy coverage, and Westminster analysis.
- [England](https://www.bbc.com/news/england): News from England including regional reporting and local developments.
- [Scotland](https://www.bbc.com/news/scotland): Scottish news covering politics, communities, health, and public affairs.
- [Wales](https://www.bbc.com/news/wales): Welsh news with national politics, local reporting, and public service coverage.
- [Northern Ireland](https://www.bbc.com/news/northern_ireland): News from Northern Ireland on politics, society, and community issues.
- [London](https://www.bbc.com/news/england/london): London-focused reporting on transport, crime, politics, and city life.

## Live & Video
- [Live](https://www.bbc.com/news/live): Rolling live pages for major breaking news events and developing stories.
- [Watch Live News](https://www.bbc.com/news/av/10462520): Live and featured BBC News video coverage and streams.
- [News Videos](https://www.bbc.com/news/videos): Video reports, explainers, interviews, and eyewitness footage from BBC News.
- [Reel](https://www.bbc.com/reel): Short-form factual video series on science, culture, travel, and global issues.
- [BBC World Service](https://www.bbc.com/ws/languages): International language services with news and audio for global audiences.

## Business, Tech & Climate
- [Business](https://www.bbc.com/news/business): Business reporting on markets, companies, personal finance, and economic trends.
- [Technology](https://www.bbc.com/news/technology): Technology news covering platforms, devices, AI, cybersecurity, and digital policy.
- [Science & Environment](https://www.bbc.com/news/science_and_environment): Reporting on science, climate, nature, health research, and the environment.
- [Climate](https://www.bbc.com/climate): Climate-focused journalism on emissions, adaptation, energy, and environmental change.
- [Future](https://www.bbc.com/future): Features exploring science, health, psychology, and evidence-based ideas.
- [Future Planet](https://www.bbc.com/future-planet): Stories on sustainability, biodiversity, climate solutions, and planetary health.

## Culture, Entertainment & Lifestyle
- [Culture](https://www.bbc.com/culture): Features and criticism on film, television, music, books, art, and style.
- [Entertainment & Arts](https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment_and_arts): News coverage of celebrities, media, film, music, and the arts.
- [Travel](https://www.bbc.com/travel): Destination stories, cultural insights, food writing, and responsible travel features.
- [Food](https://www.bbc.com/travel/columns/food): Travel-related food stories exploring cuisines, traditions, and local identity.
- [Worklife](https://www.bbc.com/worklife): Reporting on careers, workplace culture, leadership, and changing work patterns.
- [Better](https://www.bbc.com/future/better): Evidence-led features on health, wellbeing, habits, and everyday living.

## Sport
- [Sport Home](https://www.bbc.com/sport): Main sport homepage with headlines, live events, and featured competitions.
- [Football](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football): Football news, live scores, fixtures, tables, and transfer coverage.
- [Cricket](https://www.bbc.com/sport/cricket): Cricket coverage including international matches, domestic leagues, and analysis.
- [Tennis](https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis): Tennis news, tournament coverage, results, and player updates.
- [Formula 1](https://www.bbc.com/sport/formula1): Formula 1 news, race reports, standings, and technical analysis.
- [Rugby Union](https://www.bbc.com/sport/rugby-union): Rugby union coverage with fixtures, results, and tournament reporting.
- [Golf](https://www.bbc.com/sport/golf): Golf news, majors coverage, leaderboards, and player features.
- [Athletics](https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics): Athletics reporting on track, field, road racing, and championships.

## Audio & Podcasts
- [Audio Home](https://www.bbc.com/audio): Entry point for BBC podcasts, radio, music, and spoken-word audio.
- [Sounds](https://www.bbc.com/sounds): BBC Sounds platform for live radio, podcasts, music mixes, and catch-up audio.
- [Podcasts](https://www.bbc.com/podcasts): Directory of BBC podcasts across news, sport, culture, and factual genres.
- [World Service Radio](https://www.bbc.com/audio/play/live/bbc_world_service): Live stream of BBC World Service radio programming.
- [BBC Radio 4](https://www.bbc.com/sounds/play/live:bbc_radio_fourfm): Live and on-demand access to BBC Radio 4 programming.
- [BBC Radio 5 Live](https://www.bbc.com/sounds/play/live:bbc_radio_five_live): Live news and sport radio coverage from BBC Radio 5 Live.

## Weather & Utility Services
- [Weather](https://www.bbc.com/weather): Weather forecasts, maps, and local conditions for cities worldwide.
- [Newsletters](https://www.bbc.com/newsletters): BBC newsletters covering major topics, analysis, and regular briefings.
- [Mobile App](https://www.bbc.com/news/10628994): Information about BBC News apps and mobile access.
- [Contact BBC News](https://www.bbc.com/news/10725415): Contact and feedback information for BBC News audiences.

## About & Editorial Information
- [About the BBC](https://www.bbc.com/aboutthebbc): Corporate information about the BBC, its mission, and public service role.
- [BBC Editorial Guidelines](https://www.bbc.com/editorialguidelines): Editorial standards governing accuracy, impartiality, and responsible journalism.
- [BBC Complaints](https://www.bbc.com/contact/complaints): Complaints process for BBC content and services.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.bbc.com/usingthebbc/terms): Terms governing use of BBC websites, apps, and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.bbc.com/usingthebbc/privacy): Privacy information covering data use, cookies, and user rights.
- [Accessibility Help](https://www.bbc.com/accessibility): Accessibility guidance and support for using BBC digital services.
